caption: The drawing depicts two views of a round, fabric-covered object, possibly a cushion or a capped container, both shown on a plain, beige background. The upper object is seen from an elevated angle, with a cloth draped over it that hangs down on four sides. The cloth has a visible, intricate floral and leafy pattern on its top surface, while the sides are shaded, suggesting folds and volume. The lower object is shown from a more direct, slightly lower angle, focusing on the detailed design of the cover, which contains various floral and plant motifs arranged in a circular pattern. The entire composition is done in shades of gray and brown, using pencil or charcoal techniques to create subtle shading, texture, and details in the decorative elements of the cloth and the structure of the objects. There are no other objects or elements in the background; the focus is solely on these two views of the fabric-covered, round forms.
title: Economy White Cap
